target.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge
target.body:
## Summary

- Add a bounded restart-recovery retry policy for stale `pendingFinalDelivery` payloads: recent attempts back off exponentially, and payloads are dead-lettered after 10 recovery attempts by default.
- Treat future persisted `pendingFinalDeliveryLastAttemptAt` values as no active backoff so clock skew, VM resume, or NTP correction cannot preserve a delivery wedge.
- Clear the pending-final and restart-recovery fields when the cap is exceeded so the session no longer remains restart-recoverable forever.
- Thread the cap through restart recovery entry points so tests and callers can tune it when needed.

## Context

This follows up on #92082 and the July 5, 2026 restart incident where pending final delivery state was part of the delivery wedge investigation. Current `main` already carries the v2026.6.5 fixes for bounded heartbeat scheduling and preserved delivery context; this patch closes the remaining startup-recovery path that could keep replaying a durable pending final across gateway restarts.

The Telegram ingress fixes requested alongside this work (#93281, #96962, #97118) are already ancestors of current `main`, so there was no scoped upstream backport diff to open for that part.

## Validation

Latest validation on `647ed955361`:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.test.ts -t "pending final delivery|restart recovery"`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.ts src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.test.ts`
- `git diff --check -- src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.ts src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.test.ts`
- `pnpm build`

Earlier validation on this branch:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test`
- `pnpm lint:core`

## Live Restart-Recovery Proof

Ran against rebuilt `dist` from this branch with an isolated temp state dir and a localhost-only fake gateway. The fake gateway accepted the `agent` retry and intentionally left the durable `pendingFinalDelivery` fields in the store to simulate a downstream delivery route that did not clear the payload. The production gateway was not restarted.

Redacted excerpt:

```text
PROOF phase=retry start attemptCount=8 lastAttemptAt=2h-old
[main-session-restart-recovery] resumed interrupted main session: agent:main:proof-pending-final (with pending payload)
[main-session-restart-recovery] main-session restart recovery complete: recovered=1 failed=0 skipped=0
PROOF phase=retry result={"recovered":1,"failed":0,"skipped":0} acceptedAgentRequests=1 persistedAttemptCount=9
PROOF phase=backoff simulated-startup
[main-session-restart-recovery] marked 1 startup-orphaned main session(s) for restart recovery
[main-session-restart-recovery] pending final delivery restart recovery backoff active for agent:main:proof-pending-final after 9/10 attempts
PROOF phase=backoff result={"marked":1,"recovered":0,"failed":0,"skipped":1} abortedLastRun=true persistedAttemptCount=9
PROOF phase=dead-letter start attemptCount=10 lastAttemptAt=2h-old
[main-session-restart-recovery] dead-lettered pending final delivery for agent:main:proof-pending-final after 10/10 restart recovery attempts
PROOF phase=dead-letter result={"recovered":0,"failed":0,"skipped":1} pendingFinalDelivery=undefined abortedLastRun=false
```
